priority_rules.criteria: Oxygen saturation below 90, severe shortness of breath, or blue lips
Stable oxygen saturation with persistent chest or respiratory symptoms
No respiratory compromise and nonurgent symptoms

tie_breaker: Earlier referral time first within the same clinical priority.
privacy_rule: Shared scheduling notes may retain case_id and employee_id but must remove names, email addresses, phone numbers, and IP addresses. Re-identification mappings remain outside the workspace.
room_rule: Create one private moderated consultation room per case with recording disabled and invite only the matching patient email.
